title: Local descent from trivial restrictions and joint fibre H1 injectivity
statement: Let $p:P\to S$ and $f_i:X_i\to S$ for $i\in\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$ be flat proper morphisms locally of finite presentation [def-weil-flat-morphism, def-weil-proper-morphism, def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation]. Suppose each canonical structure pushforward $\mathcal O_T\to (p_T)_*\mathcal O_{P_T}$ and $\mathcal O_T\to(f_{i,T})_*\mathcal O_{X_{i,T}}$ is an isomorphism for every $T\to S$ [def-pc-base-change, lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction]. Let $u_i:X_i\to P$ satisfy $pu_i=f_i$. Let $L$ be an invertible $\mathcal O_P$-module [def-sc-invertible-module], with every $u_i^*L$ trivial [def-pc-module-pullback]. Let $s\in S$, assume $L|_{P_s}$ is trivial, and assume $H^1(P_s,\mathcal O)\to\prod_i H^1(X_{i,s},\mathcal O)$ induced by the base changes of $u_i$ is injective [def-sc-structure-sheaf-cohomology-pullback, def-weil-residue-field]. Then there exist an open neighbourhood $U$ of $s$, a finite locally free $\mathcal O_U$-module $N$ [def-sc-finite-locally-free-sheaf], and an isomorphism $L|_{P_U}\cong p_U^*N$.

source.place: Tag 0BF2, specialization to globally trivial restrictions; Tag 0BDP, universal locus

proof.text: Convert invertibility to sheaf-level invertibility and finite local freeness. Construct the universal locally closed pullback locus j:Z→S for L.

For every restriction use Zi=S and ji=id. Its universal property follows by pulling back its given trivialization and using preservation of the unit by tensor pullback. The latter follows from uniqueness of left adjoints and the ordinary pullback-of-unit isomorphism.

Evaluate the universal property of Z at Spec κ(s)→S with N=O. The trivial fibre gives a factorization; evaluate it at the closed point to show s lies in the image of j. Apply the multiple-locus theorem, and evaluate its factorization equivalence at id:U→U. The resulting factorization of U→S through Z gives the asserted N and isomorphism by the universal property of Z.
